source.guided_document: 00 — Vérité guidée des façades — BOLDÜNGO LEGO2

visual_interpretation.east_front: Front gable elevation with six principal openings over three occupied levels; pale wall and contrasting surrounds.
visual_interpretation.north: Sparse side elevation, one high window, low 6x5 glass-block opening, visibly rising street grade.
visual_interpretation.south: Two-flight masonry stair, raised masonry landing/platform with open lower circulation, deep terrace French-door reveal, raised timber deck.
visual_interpretation.west: Partially occluded rear; large zinc/metal-clad chimney volume confirmed as part of target house.
visual_interpretation.timber_deck: Open underside with posts and visible bracing; western end narrows/returns instead of remaining a uniform rectangle.
visual_interpretation.excluded: Neighbour buildings and perspective chimneys, street pole, temporary furniture/plants/site objects.

known_canonical_limit: ArchitecturalScene v0.2 has support posts but no dedicated diagonal brace primitive. Y-bracing is therefore retained as observed evidence/notes rather than mislabeled geometry.
